integrity.provenance_note: Runtime began from an uncommitted worktree at the recorded base HEAD; its nine frozen source files are content-identical to the subsequently published commit. This is not a claim that execution checked out the published commit.

recomputation.bootstrap: Independent weighted-order-statistic CVaR and paired seed-then-world percentile bootstrap; 1000 draws, RNG seed 7891.

test_input_hash_scope: These raw-input hashes were regenerated during independent review, not captured during the original run. World IDs, truth, scenario components and acquired neural encoder reports were checked against all corresponding original CSV rows.
review_type: Separate-agent post-run evidence audit with independent statistics and raw-media/checkpoint replay; not an independent-laboratory replication.

validity_assessment.conclusion: The frozen three-seed local experiment supports a small IID tail-loss improvement over its validation-selected static portfolio within the specified Linear MAC and point-estimate quality margins. It does not establish incremental NDU preference superiority over fixed-risk DP, recursive benefit at the primary budget, robustness to shared bias/correlation shift, or dedicated-cloud completion.

primary.interpretation: Observed CVaR reduction is about 3.98%; the bootstrap interval excludes zero but does not guarantee a reduction of at least 0.02. The quality condition is a prespecified point-estimate margin, not a statistical noninferiority test. Higher ambiguity must accompany the reported tail-loss result.

incremental_ndu_preference.reason: CVaR interval reaches zero; mean loss and quality are worse in point estimates.

recursion.budget7_inference_scope: Exploratory point comparison, not the registered primary claim or a new significance finding.

joint_error_model.interpretation: Evidence is consistent with useful calibrated joint-error modeling in this IID synthetic task; it does not isolate a novel NDU preference effect.

shift_failure.interpretation: Changing the common-error coalition breaks calibrated acquisition: at the primary budget all arms trust mutually agreeing corrupted text/video and miss the now-reliable image. A larger available budget is not a robustness guarantee.

common_bias_failure.interpretation: Output agreement is not correctness; coherent common-mode errors remain undetected and unrepaired.

secondary_protocol_deviations.description: The static policy assigns weights [0, 0.25, 0.75] to text/image/video in seeds 29 and 43. If image and video are missing but zero-weight text is present, fixed_portfolio falls back to uniform. This differs from the general protocol wording that uniform is used only if no acquired report is present.
secondary_protocol_deviations.disposition: Disclose the frozen implementation rule and this secondary exception; retain the original results without silently changing implementation or rerunning the same heldout set.

limitations: Three independent training seeds provide limited evidence about training variability; 169344 evaluated rows are repeated policy/budget evaluations of 8064 distinct worlds, not 169344 independent observations.

All eight semantic classes are shared between training and evaluation; heldout generalization concerns independent nuisance draws and sensor failures, not unseen semantics or natural speech/image/video distributions.
The generator is explicitly trained to approximate convex mixtures of canonical raw outputs. It is a learned but deliberately specified mixing task, not discovered general compositional intelligence.

The controller is a finite locally nested entropic-risk DP with a hand-specified bounded forward preference state. The experiment is not a continuous Merton solver, neural FBSDE solution, native Hepta integration, or joint NDU/generator training.

The main cost gate covers formula-counted dense Linear MACs on actual acquisition/generation paths. It excludes nonlinear kernels, controller operations, transfers, optimizer/backward, offline calibration and compilation; those costs are separately recorded and no total-compute superiority is established.

The original run did not persist raw heldout media or capture their hashes. Deterministic raw replay during this review verified every world truth/scenario and every acquired encoder report and supplies explicitly labeled post-run input hashes.

Original runtime git HEAD is f8c9419df6ddeb36ff8b522a50219981fb8d9345. Content hashes, not a claim about that checkout HEAD, link the actual frozen nine files to remote commit 3a3e7ef2e3c0b73840d62ac5f816f9c4ec4d66db.
The sole failed registered gate is verified dedicated-cloud execution. This local evidence cannot close that infrastructure requirement.
Secondary contrasts and budget7 differences remain exploratory; no global efficient frontier or NDU-specific superiority follows from the observed points.
